capabilities: Chat with the current note, selection, files, or whole vault in a sidebar
Run AI text transformations like fix grammar, summarize, reformat, and change tone
Search the vault semantically using vector embeddings
Create personas and scoped projects with custom system prompts
Extend the AI with MCP servers, SKILL.md files, and custom prompt actions
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Cloud providers require paid API keys; Ollama offers a fully offline option. No telemetry, per the README.
intentEvidence: AI Copilot brings Notion AI-like capabilities directly into your vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, text transformation, or semantic search, so users must leave the app or wire up separate tools to use LLMs with their notes.

relations.evidence: brings Notion AI-like capabilities directly into your vault

requires.name: LLM provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Groq)
Ollama for local models; local MCP servers for extended tools

summary: AI assistant plugin that adds a chat sidebar over your vault, text transformation commands, semantic vault search, personas, and MCP/skills extensibility.
